name: lihiket-tutoring-platform
description: Lihiket Online Tutoring Platform - React + Node.js + MongoDB

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && cp -n server/.env.example server/.env 2>/dev/null || true && cp -n client/.env.example client/.env 2>/dev/null || true
